children: Polygon CEO Marc Boiron sparked backlash on X after saying staff time off “pains me so much” because he prefers the company to move faster. According to BeInCrypto, critics called the stance a fiat mindset, while Boiron replied with a Bitcoin lesson, saying he has worked as an investor, adviser and early lawyer for bitcoin-maxi companies and arguing that Bitcoin gets harder to obtain over time. Polygon Labs cut nearly 30% of its workforce in January and trimmed staff again in July.

title: Polygon CEO Marc Boiron Sparks Backlash Over Staff Time Off
